toegepas.voor: sê net vir ander wat om te doen
toegepas.na: sê net vir ander wat hulle moet doen
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'wat om te doen' copies English 'what to do'; 'wat hulle moet doen' is the idiomatic Afrikaans form.
toegepas.fout: 'wat om te doen' copies English 'what to do'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'wat hulle moet doen' is the natural Afrikaans form and says exactly the same thing.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The quoted trait follows 'is' directly and reads as broken grammar; a colon marks it as the list item's name and leaves the protected wording intact.
toegepas.fout: the trait's name follows 'is egter' directly as a bare verb phrase, so the sentence stumbles on a first reading
toegepas.rede_keurder: The colon marks the list item as a quoted name, leaves the protected wording intact and changes no meaning.

laat_vaar.voor: Die tweede eienskap vra dat sy
laat_vaar.na: Die tweede eienskap beteken dat sy
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'vra' was just used for the leader asking people, and a trait that 'asks that she' reads wooden; 'beteken' is clearer for Grade 4.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Die eienskap vra dat' is natural Afrikaans for 'requires', and 'beteken' turns a demand of the trait into a definition of it, which moves the claim.

laat_vaar.voor: vra ook na die span se idees en gebruik die beste idee
laat_vaar.na: vra ook die span vir hulle idees en gebruik die beste een
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'vra na' means to ask after or inquire about; 'iemand vir iets vra' is the natural construction, and 'die beste een' avoids repeating 'idee'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'na die span se idees vra' is standard Afrikaans, and 'die beste een' brings back the English calque a previous round judged a fault and the writer replaced on purpose.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In the list it is the only item starting with a capital letter; the other seven start lower case, so the list looks inconsistent. Only the case would change, not the words.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: 'n taak wat hy goed kan doen
laat_vaar_vorige.na: 'n taak wat hy of sy goed kan doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The leader is 'sy' throughout, so a bare 'hy' for 'elkeen' right after 'Sy' jars; the lesson already uses 'sy of haar' elsewhere.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Generic 'hy' after 'elkeen' is standard Afrikaans and cannot point to the leader, who is 'Sy'; adding 'of sy' puts a second 'sy' in the sentence that could be read as the leader.
